entries.zh: 买来转卖；为转售而买入
entries.en: to buy from another in order to resell; to buy for resale
entries.notes: H 栏疑为「買來賣」（原录作羅），M/R 对音未与汉字密合，义取转手买卖。

entries.zh: 纳粟（捐纳粟米以取得官位，即买官）
entries.en: to buy a mandarin's office; to obtain official rank by a grain contribution (納粟)
entries.notes: L 栏「offo」当为 oficio（官职）；H「納粟」与 R「na zo」相合。
整行被划删，汉字作「—」、闽南语栏空缺，仅存西语「Começallo」残迹。

entries.en: the public; the commonality; public (as a collective)

entries.zh: 熟谙；通晓、深通（对人、对事熟悉）
entries.en: to be well versed in; to know well; to communicate fluently
entries.notes: H 栏疑为「諳」，M/R 作 im/in，与此字常读未密合，义据「諳」之熟习义。
H 栏录作「福諳」（疑），M/R 均为 hok-im，音指向「福音」，惟 L「Comunicar bien」义未全合。

entries.zh: 互相沟通；互通音信（「相」表相互，后二字承前条待考）
entries.en: to communicate with one another; to be in mutual communication
entries.notes: 仅「相」之相互义与 L「ad inuices」相合，「福諳」所指未定。

entries.zh: 知心人；知己、彼此交心之人
entries.en: confidant; intimate friend; those who open their hearts to each other
with (comitative preposition; the 'con' construed with the ablative)
with; together with; to join, to combine
entries.notes: R 栏作「nung ho」，与「合」对音未密合，义据 H 与 M（cap/kap）。

entries.en: both; comprising one and the other; concurrently
all together and with all force; to exhaust one's strength

entries.zh: 尽我之力；拼尽全部力气
entries.en: with all my strength; with might and main
with all one's strength; to do one's utmost

entries.notes: 汉字、闽南语、官话三栏皆空，仅存西语「con instancia」（急切、坚持），无从定夺。

entries.en: with all one's physical strength; sparing no effort

entries.zh: 尽情；全心全意、尽其心意
entries.en: with all one's will; wholeheartedly; to one's heart's content
